_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Government Furnished Property Plan
summary: The Government Furnished Property Plan describes the contractor's Property Management System for monitoring and tracking Government-furnished property in accordance with FAR 52.245-1 and DFARS requirements.
use_relationship:
This report covers the property plan for contractors to submit Government Furnished Property.

This document applies to property furnished to and managed by the Contractor. Describe the Contractor's Property Management System (PMS) that will be used to monitor and track property. The PMS consists of electronic systems, written procedures or instructions and processes for functional outcome areas. Contractor shall address all ten Outcome Areas detailed in FAR 52.245-1, paragraphs b and f, and in accordance with DFARS 252.245-7003 and 252.245-7005.

The property plan will define roles and responsibilities, contractual requirements, industry leading practices (ILP), voluntary consensus standards (VCS), customary commercial practices, and continuous process improvement methods used in PMS.

Adjustments to corporate property plans specific to contract or delivery orders can be detailed in an appendix to standard plan.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The property plan will define roles and responsibilities, contractual requirements, industry leading practices (ILP), voluntary consensus standards (VCS), customary commercial practices, and continuous process improvement methods utilized in the contractor's PMS.

children.title: Major elements of the data to be delivered by the Contractor.
children.content:
Contractor shall address outcome areas detailed in FAR 52.245-1 paragraphs b and f:
1. Acquisition
2. Receiving
3. Records
4. Physical Inventory
5. Subcontractor Control
6. Reports
7. Relief of Stewardship
8. Utilization
9. Maintenance
10. Property Closeout

Contractor will detail the applicable outcome areas and describe frequency and performance of both physical inventories and independent self-assessment of their respective PMS.
